name: prompt-enhancer
description: A ✦ enhance chip above the prompt, or /enhance <text>: asks what your draft leaves out, then writes it three ways (Tight, Balanced, Thorough) following Anthropic's and OpenAI's prompting guidance. Use it, send it or copy it.

model.title: Model
model.description: session (the default): this session's own model, reading the conversation from the prompt cache. Or haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id: that model, sent the last messages of the conversation as an excerpt.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: How hard a model other than session thinks. default: the model's own.

chip.title: Show the chip
chip.description: The ✦ enhance chip above the prompt. Off: /enhance only.
